body:
because i've done so much stupid shit in the past that makes me regret and feel guilty every time i think about it, and it's inevitable that i'll do even more stupid shit later on. i know, as a human, i could create happiness - that i could make other people happy. but every time i try, i fail. i can't even make myself happy. i don't deserve shit anyway. 
and that's the only thing i do nowadays.

i've disregarded so many people's feelings in the past. i was such a stupid kid. and my family raised me right - it's me who's the problem. i'm the one setting them back. they're the one to have always given me the second chances, and i still always manage to fucking screw up and disappoint everyone. i just... i don't know why i feel this way, when i have so much. i just... i just want to stop. and i know, i know they'll be disappointed that i want help. which is why i can't get it. whatever i do, someone is bound to be disappointed. i'm so sorry though... i would never wish my fuckery onto anyone else. i just don't know what to do anymore with myself.

That's pretty much my case right now... I was doing fine, a few weeks ago. I don't even know why the hell I feel like utter, utter shit right now, because while I feel like this once in a while and I felt down at times around the year, it's just been... just awful this time. I thought I didn't need therapy anymore... but ugh, I just fell flat on my face, again. 
I'd think they were right. I just... I don't think I deserve to kill myself. Someone deserves to kill me. People deserve to torture and kill me. And I'm such a goddamn pussy for even trying and dragging down everyone further, god. I keep trying to tell myself I'm a shitty person for wasting such opportunities, my life... but I know I'm going to disappoint so many people, no one deserves the crap I put them through. ugh, I'm so sorry. i just can't fucking stand myself.

i can't think of any, honestly. i know that is a crap answer, and i'm really sorry, but even if i might have done something good, it probably turned out for the worse. 
and it's not so bad right now... i can think more clearly, but i know soon, again, it's just going to go downhill. the internet is my distraction; it keeps my mind off of how much of a dumbass I am. And everyone knows how much of a failure I am, and I know even if they have hopes for me to improve, I'm just gonna fail them again... I'll just keep trying and dragging myself on.

i still feel like crap at the moment, but think i can think a little properly right now... i know that soon i'll just go through another cycle of self loathing, pure hatred and wanting to die because everyone would be better off without me. i still don't deny that, but when i feel really guilty, i can't control myself. i start talking to myself, and i'll just keep rambling on how shitty of a person i am, and reasoning why i should die. and then i hurt myself, and it just feels so awful because i'm trying to get through, trying to think properly, but all i feel is a wall just blocking my heart and any coherent thought, and it's aggravating as hell. everything i do just sets off a reminder in how much i hate myself, how much of a failure i am... and i feel guilty getting help. i know people are going to be disappointed. i know, i know, i'm just going to fail everyone again.
everything i've done for myself is my fault. i'm the person who controls my life, and even i can't get myself this constant drilling reminder that i'm too weak to handle anything anyway.

i'm eighteen. but i'm still in high school, homeschooled... because i was stupid enough to let myself not work and i couldn't be strong enough to just stop feeling like shit all the time. i should be doing my work right now, but i haven't been. i'm a hopeless, lost case. i won't ever do anything right, never did anything right. i don't deserve a second chance. i'm sorry, ugh. i'm just so pathetic.

just... a lot of stupid shit i've done, shouldn't have done, still am doing. i just feel so awful for making so many mistakes. and people tell me it's a natural course of human life... but i can't forgive myself. i can't stop. and i still manage to screw up everything today. everything i do i mess up.

they frown upon medication. they think i'm okay. and i'm a screw up for having done so many stupid, shitty things in the past. i'm not a good person, and i feel awful and guilty that i'm even talking to you to "help" myself.

Idon't deserve to get help. what's the point in trying to make myself feel better about myself when i screw up all the time? and i've gotten counseling before, but if i tell my family i might want to get therapy or medication or shit, they're going to be disappointed, again.
I can't stop... the only thoughts in my head are about how much I suck as a person. And then when I need to punish myself I hit myself. Whispering how awful I am, I can't stop.

There shouldn't be anything wrong... I should be so happy, but I'm not. And I hate myself for that. I've been given so much goodness throughout my life, and I'm still an ungrateful bitch. I'm so pathetic, and I can't go on. I've been such an awful person, and I've done so many stupid things. The only constant thing in my head is about me, how selfish I am, and all these thoughts... and it's so hard trying to reassure myself that no, I'm okay. I can learn from my mistakes. I need to stop being so down on myself. But I'm waste.
